integrity: Analytic universal proof with exact example and independently executable finite consistency checker; no empirical calibration, no claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Risk-neutral, homogeneous nonatomic population; independent Poisson contact attempts; fixed exogenous prevalence over behavioral adjustment; multiplicative contact attenuation and constant costs. Endogenous epidemic and finite-population evolutionary dynamics are not covered. Closely related full text published in 2025 was unavailable for comparison.
title: A sharp bistability window for voluntary masking under finite-horizon Poisson exposure
